title: Flame of the Fallen
summary: Engulfed in ancient hellfire, Ha-Jun fuses the cooling circulation of the Ring of Hollow Blood with the thermal insulation of the Bone Gauntlet to tame the Flame of the Fallen.

panels.shot: raging violet hellfire tornado wide shot
panels.action: The 50-foot pillar of violet-crimson hellfire roars toward the cavern ceiling, lighting up the magma lake.
panels.prose_en: The 50-foot pillar of violet-crimson hellfire roars toward the cavern ceiling, lighting up the magma lake.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni-lal rang ki narkankaal ki aag ka 50 foot ka khambha gufa ki chhat ki or garjta hai, jisse magma jheel jagmaga uthti hai.

panels.shot: kuro shielding eyes with wings on distant pillar
panels.action: Kuro is blown back to a distant basalt rock, struggling against the blistering thermal shockwave.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: HA-JUN!! APNA MIND CONTROL MAT KHONA!!

panels.prose_en: Kuro is blown back to a distant basalt rock, struggling against the blistering thermal shockwave.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro prachand thermal shockwev ke khilaf sangharsh karte hue door sthit basalt chattan par wapas chala jata hai.

panels.shot: inside the inferno ha-jun screaming in agony
panels.action: Inside the vortex, Ha-Jun grinds his teeth as violet fire scorches through his clothes, searing his skin.
panels.prose_en: Inside the vortex, Ha-Jun grinds his teeth as violet fire scorches through his clothes, searing his skin.
panels.prose_hi: Bhanvar ke ander, ha-jun apne daant pista hai jaise baingani rang ki aag uske kapdon ko jhulsa deti hai, jisse uski tvacha jhulas jaati hai.

panels.shot: skin charring and blistering
panels.action: Blisters and black scorch marks spread across his forearms as temperatures exceed 2,000 degrees.
panels.prose_en: Blisters and black scorch marks spread across his forearms as temperatures exceed 2,000 degrees.
panels.prose_hi: Tapman 2,000 degree se adhik hone par uski banhon par chhale aur jhulsane ke kale nishan fail gaye.

panels.shot: bone gauntlet glowing with cool ivory light
panels.action: His left Bone Gauntlet glows with glacial pale light, insulating his arm bones and preventing marrow boil.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bone Gauntlet meri haddiyon ko protect kar rahi hai... Lekin mera blood boil ho raha hai!

panels.prose_en: His left Bone Gauntlet glows with glacial pale light, insulating his arm bones and preventing marrow boil.
panels.prose_hi: Unka bayan bone gauntlet himachadit pili roshni se chamakta hai, unki baanh ki haddiyon ko surakshit rakhta hai aur majja ko ubalne se rokta hai.

panels.shot: ring of hollow blood spinning wildly
panels.action: The obsidian ring spins around his finger like a miniature turbine, drinking in ambient heat.
panels.prose_en: The obsidian ring spins around his finger like a miniature turbine, drinking in ambient heat.
panels.prose_hi: Obseedian ring uski ungli ke charon or ek laghu turbine ki tarah ghumti hai, jo parivesh ki garmi ko peeti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun realizing the combination strategy
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes widen through the smoke as the connection clicks in his mind.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Blood ring heat ko absorb kar sakti hai... Aur Bone gauntlet shock absorb karti hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes widen through the smoke as the connection clicks in his mind.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi connection uske dimag mein click karta hai, ha-jun ki aankhen dhuen ke karan chaudi ho jaati han.

panels.shot: ha-jun circulating blood mana in reverse
panels.action: Ha-Jun reverses his mana flow, drawing boiling crimson blood from his core into the cold bone channels.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reverses his mana flow, drawing boiling crimson blood from his core into the cold bone channels.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne man pravah ko ulat deta hai, aur uske core se ubalta lal rakt thandi haddi channelon mein khinchta hai.

panels.shot: boiling blood cooling through bone matrix
panels.action: A stunning visualization shows scalding crimson blood flowing through ivory bone channels, cooling to liquid amethyst.
panels.prose_en: A stunning visualization shows scalding crimson blood flowing through ivory bone channels, cooling to liquid amethyst.
panels.prose_hi: Ek aashcharyajanak drishya mein hathi daant ki haddi ki nalikaon se jalta hua lal rang ka rakt bahta hua dikhai deta hai, jo thanda hokar taral neelam mein badal jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun grasping the ashen heart with both hands
panels.action: Ha-Jun plunges both hands directly into the core of the burning volcanic heart.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun plunges both hands directly into the core of the burning volcanic heart.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun donon hathon ko sidhe jalte hue jwalamukhi hriday ke kendra mein dalta hai.

panels.shot: volcanic heart resisting with violent sparks
panels.action: The Ashen Heart thrashes in his grip, unleashing jagged bolts of black-and-purple lightning.
panels.prose_en: The Ashen Heart thrashes in his grip, unleashing jagged bolts of black-and-purple lightning.
panels.prose_hi: Ation heart uski pakad mein dhadkata hai, kale aur baingani bijli ke dantedar bolt ko ujagar karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun shouting with sovereign authority
panels.action: Ha-Jun roars with the vocal weight of a primordial emperor, his voice echoing in ten dimensions.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: JHUK JAO!! MAIN HEIR HOON IS BLOODLINE KA!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun roars with the vocal weight of a primordial emperor, his voice echoing in ten dimensions.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek aadim samrat ki awaaz ke saath dahadta hai, uski awaaz das aayamon mein goonjati hai.

panels.shot: the first sovereign giant shadow manifests
panels.action: Behind Ha-Jun, the towering four-horned silhouette of the First Demon Sovereign overlaps his frame.
panels.prose_en: Behind Ha-Jun, the towering four-horned silhouette of the First Demon Sovereign overlaps his frame.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke pichhe, pratham danav samprabhu ka vishal char seeng wala silhut uske frame ko overlap karta hai.

panels.shot: ashen heart stopping its violent thrashing
panels.action: Recognizing the primordial authority, the volcanic heart instantly ceases its struggle.
panels.prose_en: Recognizing the primordial authority, the volcanic heart instantly ceases its struggle.
panels.prose_hi: Aadim satta ko pahchankar, jwalamukhiya hriday turant apna sangharsh band kar deta hai.

panels.shot: heart disintegrating into purple liquid flame
panels.action: The solid charred heart dissolves into a concentrated orb of glowing liquid violet hellfire.
panels.prose_en: The solid charred heart dissolves into a concentrated orb of glowing liquid violet hellfire.
panels.prose_hi: Thos jala hua hriday chamakte taral baingani narkankaal ke ek sankendrit gole mein vilin ho jata hai.

panels.shot: liquid fire sinking into ha-jun solar plexus
panels.action: The sphere of violet flame sinks directly into the center of Ha-Jun's chest, right over his heart.
panels.prose_en: The sphere of violet flame sinks directly into the center of Ha-Jun's chest, right over his heart.
panels.prose_hi: Baingani lau ka gola sidhe ha-jun ki chhati ke kendra men, uske hriday ke theek upar dhansta hai.

panels.shot: pillar of fire imploding inward
panels.action: The massive 50-foot tornado of fire suddenly implodes inward, sucked entirely into Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_en: The massive 50-foot tornado of fire suddenly implodes inward, sucked entirely into Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Aag ka 50 foot ka vishal bavandar achanak andar ki or futata hai aur puri tarah se ha-jun ki chhati mein sama jata hai.

panels.shot: shockwave of cool wind across magma lake
panels.action: A clean shockwave of cool amethyst wind ripples across the boiling lava, freezing the surface into obsidian crust.
panels.prose_en: A clean shockwave of cool amethyst wind ripples across the boiling lava, freezing the surface into obsidian crust.
panels.prose_hi: Thandi neelam hawa ki ek saaf shockwev ubalte hue lava par tarangit hoti hai, jo satah ko obsidian crust mein jama deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing in steam mist
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands motionless in the rising steam, his clothes shredded, exposing his bare athletic chest.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands motionless in the rising steam, his clothes shredded, exposing his bare athletic chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun badhti bhaap mein gatiheen khada hai, uske kapde fat gaye han, jisse uski nangi athletic chhati ujagar ho rahi hai.

panels.shot: blazing violet flame crest burning on chest
panels.action: Etched into the skin over his sternum: a glowing violet-and-crimson demonic lotus crest of fire.
panels.prose_en: Etched into the skin over his sternum: a glowing violet-and-crimson demonic lotus crest of fire.
panels.prose_hi: Uske urosthi ke upar ki tvacha mein khuda hua: aag ka ek chamakta hua baingani aur lal rang ka rakshasi kamal ka shikhar.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening right palm
panels.action: Ha-Jun raises his right hand and gently flexes his ring finger.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises his right hand and gently flexes his ring finger.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna dahina haath uthata hai aur apni anamika ko dheere se modata hai.

panels.shot: wisp of violet flame dancing on fingertip
panels.action: A mesmerizing miniature flame of violet hellfire ignites on his fingertip, burning without consuming oxygen.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Flame of the Fallen... Yeh aag kisi physical fuel se nahi, mere will se chalti hai.

panels.prose_en: A mesmerizing miniature flame of violet hellfire ignites on his fingertip, burning without consuming oxygen.
panels.prose_hi: Uski ungaliyon par baingani narkankaal ki ek mantramugdh kar dene wali laghu jwala prajvalit hoti hai, jo oxygen ka upbhog kiye bina jalti hai.

panels.shot: coating the blood katana in violet fire
panels.action: Ha-Jun manifests The Sanguine Fang; the crimson blade instantly ignites with crackling violet flames.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun manifests The Sanguine Fang; the crimson blade instantly ignites with crackling violet flames.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun the senguin fang ko prakat karta hai; crimson blade turant karkash baingani lapton ke saath prajvalit ho jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder with awe
panels.action: Kuro stares at the flaming blood blade in stunned wonder: 'Incredible... First Sovereign ki exact technique!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The Bloodfire Katana! Teen relics ek saath harmonise ho gaye!

panels.prose_en: Kuro stares at the flaming blood blade in stunned wonder: 'Incredible... First Sovereign ki exact technique!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro stabdh aashcharya se dhadhakte rakt blade ko dekhta hai: 'avishwasniy... pehli sovereign ki sateek taknik!'.

panels.shot: system interface milestone alert
panels.action: A massive golden interface scrolls down with dramatic celestial sound.

dialogue.text:
[RELIC BONDED: THE ASHEN HEART (BASIC)]
Synchronization: 35.0%
New Element Unlocked: Demonic Hellfire (Rank D)
Attribute Fusion: Blood + Fire = Sanguine Pyre.

panels.prose_en: A massive golden interface scrolls down with dramatic celestial sound.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vishal sunhara interface natakiya akashiya dhwani ke saath neeche scroll karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun swinging flaming blade once
panels.action: Ha-Jun swings the flaming blade toward a distant 50-foot rock overhang.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun swings the flaming blade toward a distant 50-foot rock overhang.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun jwalant blade ko door 50 foot ki chattan ki or ghumata hai.

panels.shot: distant rock overhang sliced and incinerated
panels.action: The massive rock formation is cleaved in half and instantly vaporized into fine violet ash before falling.
panels.prose_en: The massive rock formation is cleaved in half and instantly vaporized into fine violet ash before falling.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal chattan aadhe hisse mein toot jaati hai aur girne se pehle turant mahin baingani raakh mein vashpikrit ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun dispelling the blade with a breath
panels.action: Ha-Jun exhales; the flaming blade dissolves back into his ring without expending an ounce of waste.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun exhales; the flaming blade dissolves back into his ring without expending an ounce of waste.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sans chhodta hai; jalta hua blade ek auns bhi barbad kiye bina wapas uski ring mein ghul jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro looking at ha-jun chest crest
panels.action: Kuro gestures to Ha-Jun's glowing chest: 'Lekin yeh abhi khatam nahi hua... Tri-Relic resonance shuru ho rahi hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Teeno Basic Relics ek saath activate ho rahe hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro gestures to Ha-Jun's glowing chest: 'Lekin yeh abhi khatam nahi hua... Tri-Relic resonance shuru ho rahi hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ha-jun ki chamakti chhati ki or ishara karta hai: 'lakin yeh abhi khatam nahin hua... tri-avshesh pratidhvani shuru ho rahi hai!'.

panels.shot: all three relics glowing simultaneously
panels.action: Kuro's Feather, the Blood Ring, and the Bone Gauntlet pulse in golden-violet harmony.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh feeling... Jaise mere andar ka koi tala hamesha ke liye toot raha ho!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's Feather, the Blood Ring, and the Bone Gauntlet pulse in golden-violet harmony.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ka pankh, rakt valay aur asthi gauntlet sunahre-bangni samanjasya mein spandit hote han.
